• Mohun Bagan Super Giant vs Chennaiyin FC || Match Content || Highlights || Match 17 || 26-Oct-2026 || English ||
Salt Lake finally gets its moment! Watch the big moments as Mohun Bagan Super Giant beat Chennaiyin FC 1-0 to win their first home game of the MG Indian Super League 2026-27.
Chennaiyin held firm in Kolkata for most of the night, but Manvir Singh found the breakthrough five minutes from time to give the Mariners a second straight win. Mohun Bagan move on to six points from three games, while Chennaiyin have now gone two matches without a goal.
